Resolves #21844

Related: #21346 · Companion cover: neomjs/pages#159 (merge cover first so `devmode/gantt-cascade-14.jpg` is live when the catalog entry lands on `dev`)

Adds `examples/gantt/cascade` (`"A late task moves the plan"`), an office-move Gantt example answering what happens when one task slips: twelve fixed-date November 2026 tasks model a ten-task Finish-to-Start relocation chain (`Sign the lease` → `First day in the new office` on `Mon 16 Nov`) alongside two linked tasks beside the chain (`Redirect mail & billing` → `Clean & return old keys`). Pressing `"Delay the cabling by a week"` (`fa-clock`) or dragging the `Install data cabling` bar invokes `Neo.gantt.Container` with `cascadeDependencies: true` and `animateCascade: true`, gliding the seven downstream tasks and links to `Mon 23 Nov` while leaving the two upstream tasks and two beside-the-chain tasks untouched, and updating the single-line schedule readout above the plan from `taskChange`.

Evidence: L3 (6-arm empirical browser drive on `examples/gantt/basic`, whitebox Neural Link E2E in `CascadeNL.spec.mjs` + `PlanningThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs`, 2× bit-identical cover capture via `captureExamples.mjs`, and 4-frame cold visual read at `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844`) → L3 required (#21844 AC-1..AC-7).

### Step-1 Empirical Drive (`examples/gantt/basic`)
Drove all 6 arms (`moveTask` button + pointer bar drag × `cascadeDependencies: true/false` × `animateCascade: true/false`) in headless Chromium before authoring: zero engine defects; `taskChange` emits `{action, cascaded, changeSource, changes, changesById, previousById, record, startDate, endDate}`; API `moveTask` animates `[edited, ...cascaded]` (`50` distinct sampled frames) while pointer drag settles the dragged bar at its drop position and animates `cascaded` (`52` distinct sampled frames). `Viewport#trackMotionSettlement` exposes `.is-cascading` while `gantt.drawnSpans.size > 0` so deterministic cover capture waits for `.cascade-viewport.is-slipped:not(.is-cascading)`.

Frame critique: On the initial `390 × 844` render (`Sign the lease` at `Mon 2 Nov`, `left: 0px`), the cold reader flagged the left rounded border of `Sign the lease` and the incoming arrowhead into `Approve desk floor plan` sitting flush against the `Task` column divider — fixed by starting `Sign the lease` on `Tue 3 Nov` (`1d`) and `Approve desk floor plan` on `Wed 4 Nov` (`1d`), re-shooting all four frames above (`ff7660130f`). On `390 × 844`, 1-day bars (`~8 px` wide) omit inner bar text (named in the left `Task` column) and stepped FS connectors route tightly around narrow bars at 28-day phone density, which keeps the entire 12-row move chain visible in frame without horizontal scrolling; `Delay the cabling by a week` stays active after one press by design so repeated `+7d` slips and `Reset` remain operable.

## Cold look

One reader without source/ticket context (`research` helper `f6cb8094`, `gemini-4-hydrogen-tiered-high`) read all four dark frames cold against *"What happened to the plan?"*:
- Identified `"Install data cabling"` (`Cabling`, amber) delaying by `+7` days (`Thu 5–Fri 6 Nov` → `Thu 12–Fri 13 Nov`) across a 1-week incoming connector gap, cascading all 7 dependent tasks (`Mount server rack`, `Turn up fibre & Wi-Fi`, `Deliver & wire desks`, `Fit monitors & docks`, `Test badge access & alarms`, `Move team crates`, `First day in the new office`) by `+7` days so move day slipped from `Mon 16 Nov` to `Mon 23 Nov` (`8 tasks moved (1 delayed + 7 dependent)`).
- Confirmed both upstream tasks (`Sign the lease`, `Approve desk floor plan`) and both dashed tasks beside the chain (`Redirect mail & billing` → `Clean & return old keys`) kept their original dates at both `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844`, and surfaced the `390 × 844` `Sign the lease` left-divider contact resolved in `ff7660130f`.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: `trackMotionSettlement` polls `gantt.drawnSpans` every 24 ms, because `Neo.gantt.CascadeMotion` signals nothing when a move lands: `end()` clears `drawnSpans` and fires no event. The poll is correct and bounded (Reset and `destroy` clear it). But visitors read examples as reference code, and this one teaches polling an internal map. It is not a Required Action here, since #21844 scopes engine changes out. The clean fix is an event from `CascadeMotion#end`, after which the example drops its timer.
- Non-blocking: at 1440 × 900 the twelve rows end at about 575 of 900 CSS px, so the lower third of the frame is empty. The Look AC is met as worded; a taller `rowHeight` at desktop width would fill it. That is the design steward's call.
